column1: # Portal 1.0.3, SDK 13.3.0. Valve's Source engine (NVIDIA Lightspeed Studios' Switch port): 28 NRO modules, NVN, shaders as GLSLC outputs.
# Mac bring-up and validation: README.md beside this profile.
# main imports from none of the subsdks; the NROs import GLSLC (subsdk0: materialsystem.nro and video_nx.nro) and the movie library (subsdk2: video_nx.nro).
# subsdk1 is NVIDIA's OpenGL driver, never loaded
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon
# The registered build selects near-zero NVN depth; offline pipeline bases use main0_z.
